content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT ISM Dhanbad ANRF Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26 August 2026 (Wednesday). Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position at IIT ISM Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 26 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this JRF role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech./M.Tech. in Applied Geophysics/Applied Geology/Petroleum Exploration/BS-MS in Earth Science or an equivalent degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. Qualification in GATE/CSIR-UGC NET is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per the institute's norms, if hostel accommodation is not provided.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your updated CV and testimonials as a single PDF to the PI's email addresses: [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online or offline interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of ANRF Junior Research Fellow at IIT ISM Dhanbad is a temporary role, likely for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ANRF/ECRG/2024/002107/EAS.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT ISM Dhanbad offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The age limit details are as per the norms of the Govt. of India/DST-ANRF for JRF recruitment. Specific relaxation details would be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the subject line required for the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line for your application email should be: “Application for the position of ANRF-JRF under SRDP/1197/G”.
